test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Shiv Kumar Sharma is associated with which instrument?
solution:
The correct answer is __Santoor__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Santoor -

 
 
• It is an Indian instrument that is trapezoidal in shape.
 
• The traditional instruments of Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• Other proponents are Ulhas Bapat and Rahul Sharma.
 
 
 
• Pandit Shiv Kumar Sharma -
 
 
• He was a Santoor player and a music composer.
 
• Awarded with Sangeet Natak Akademi Award, Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan.
 
• He passed away recently on May 10th,2022.
